verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
gutter humming
with the small work of thaw—
someone wakes up late

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
morning light
pooled on the unmade sheets—
the tea's gone cold again

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
steam long gone
still I cup my hands
around the empty mug

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a crow lands
on the frost-bare branch outside—
warms nothing, waits anyway

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the window fogs
where I've been breathing on it—
one small warm thing I made

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
I wipe it clear
just to watch the fog return—
some things I let happen twice

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the glass keeps no shape
long as I breathe into it—
so I keep breathing
